metadata.article_title: Admission of execution by party to attested document

article.title: Admission of execution by party to attested document
article.content: The admission of a party to an attested document of its execution by himself shall be sufficient proof of its execution as against him, though it be a document required by law to be attested.
article.html:
69Admission of execution by party to attested document

Section 69 · Part III · Chapter V

The admission of a party to an attested document of its execution by himself shall be sufficient proof of its execution as against him, though it be a document required by law to be attested.
